source: Retrofit extension rules (Retrofit's own, PRD 6.6). Not in APPETITE_GUIDELINES.pdf: they can raise REFER or a contradiction and feed the premium, and they never touch the appetite score.

citation.quote: Retrofit's own rule: at least 50% of TIV in sprinklered buildings is target and earns the sprinklered rate.
Retrofit's own rule: less than 50% of TIV sprinklered, on $100M of TIV or less, is acceptable at the unsprinklered rate.

rules.fixHint: Sprinkler the largest unsprinklered buildings until at least half of TIV is protected.

citation.quote: Retrofit's own rule: less than 50% of TIV sprinklered on more than $100M of TIV is referred to an underwriter.

rules.fixHint: Sprinkler the largest unsprinklered buildings until at least half of TIV is protected.

citation.quote: Retrofit's own rule: a TIV-weighted protection class of 4 or better is target.
Retrofit's own rule: a TIV-weighted protection class worse than 4 and better than 9 is acceptable.
Retrofit's own rule: a TIV-weighted protection class of 9 or 10 is effectively unprotected and is referred to an underwriter.

interpretations.title: Extension rules are Retrofit's, not Federato's
interpretations.decision: Sprinkler and protection-class rules are labelled as Retrofit's own everywhere. They can raise REFER or a contradiction and feed the premium; they carry no weight and never change the appetite score.

citation.quote: They can raise REFER or a contradiction and feed the premium, and they never touch the appetite score, so the score stays defensible against Federato's document.
